description: Calendar Pro by OKVIZ is a versatile and feature-rich calendar visual designed to enhance your Power BI reports. It offers unparalleled flexibility with customizable granularity and grouping options, allowing you to tailor the calendar view to your specific data analysis needs. Whether you are working with Gregorian, Fiscal, or Weekly calendar systems, Calendar Pro seamlessly adapts to provide accurate date representations. The visual also supports the inclusion of events and holidays from various countries, enriching your data context. With advanced color rules and extensive customization capabilities, Calendar Pro enables you to create visually appealing and informative calendar views that integrate smoothly into your Power BI dashboards. Key Features Customizable granularity and grouping Support for different calendar systems (Gregorian, Fiscal, Weekly, ...) Events and holidays from various countries Advanced color rules Extensive customization capabilities Licensing Options Calendar Pro can be licensed with different licensing models.
